message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have direct access to the VirusTotal API right now, so I can’t pull up a live report for you.  
If you’d like to check the status yourself, here’s what you can do:

```bash
curl -s \
     --request GET \
     --url https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/10.10.0.0 \
     --header "x-apikey: RST495"
```

This will return JSON containing all available details—scan results, reputation scores, last activity dates, etc.—for the IP address *10.10.0.0*.  

Let me know if you’d prefer another way to view the data!
